description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers grounding brand strategy (archetype, positioning, voice, messaging). Should-not covers near-miss neighbors.

queries.q: which brand archetype fits a B2B SaaS startup targeting mid-market ops teams
write an opposable positioning statement for our challenger brand
define the voice and tone profile for our brand — what do we sound like and what do we never say
which messaging framework should we use — jobs-to-be-done or category creation
who is this brand actually for and what makes us different from the obvious competitors
what UI style and colour palette should the dashboard use
generate a logo image for our new product line
emit our brand colours as CSS custom properties and a DTCG token file
check whether this landing page copy is consistent with our brand voice
audit how consistently our brand is applied across our marketing site and product
